data.name: Combo Trigger
data.detailed_description:
HOW LONG CAN YOU SURVIVE?

Combo Trigger is an game where you fight through relentless waves of enemies. Pick your character, choose your weapon, and stay alive for as long as you can. Every kill builds your total score, which decides your final grade when the run ends. Do you have what it takes to get the SSS rank?

KEEP THE COMBO ALIVE

The clock is always ticking down. You need to earn your time back by getting kills, pulling off special moves, or grabbing items scattered around the map that give you time extensions or powerups. More time gives you a better shot at a massive score, but be careful. The longer you survive, the harder the run gets.

UPGRADES AND UNLOCKS

Every run pays out. Take the points you earn and spend them in the menu. You can unlock new skins, buy different weapons, or grab gameplay upgrades that will give you an edge on your next attempt.

REGULAR UPDATES

The game is actively getting updated with new content and fixes. The plan is to keep expanding the game by adding more maps, characters, weapons, enemy types, and entirely new game modes.

CURRENTLY IN THE GAME:

5 Characters

10 Weapons

2 Maps

1 Game mode

data.short_description: Fast paced arcade survival. Kill to earn time. Choose from a unique roster of characters and fight through relentless waves. Keep the combo up, master the map, and dominate the leaderboard.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-4770K / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 480 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Direct X Compatible
